title: ci.pipeline.status v1
description: Emitted by the ci-watch adapter (adapters/ci-watch/) on a workflow-run state TRANSITION (green->red, red->green, first-seen-red) for a watched GitHub Actions workflow on a watched branch, plus at most one persistent-red reminder per 24h while a workflow stays red. Never emitted per-poll for an unchanged state -- that would spam the bus every 30 minutes for every long-red workflow. Closes a measured gap (2026-08-30): red mains nobody was watching (shader-garden Test battery red 3 days, deer-flow Frontend Unit Tests red on main, tengine cpu-extended red, career-ops 3 red workflows, orca Node next compatibility red, hearth CI showing skipped on main).

repo.description: owner/name of the GitHub repository (e.g. warxhead1/shader-garden)

workflow.description: GitHub Actions workflow display name (workflowName from `gh run list`), e.g. 'Test battery'

branch.description: headBranch the run was on (usually the repo's default branch, but roster.json can watch others)

state.description: Newly computed state for the most recent concluded run of this workflow on this branch. 'pending' (in-progress run, no conclusion yet) never triggers an event on its own.

prev_state.description: State recorded on the previous poll for this repo+workflow+branch. 'unknown' means this is the first time ci-watch has observed this workflow (first-seen-red still fires if state is red).

run_url.description: HTML URL of the run that produced this state (gh run list .url)

head_sha.description: Commit SHA of the run that produced this state

red_since.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the first run observed red in the current unbroken red streak, or null if state is not red

consecutive_failures.description: Number of consecutive most-recent runs (as sampled, up to the --limit window) that concluded non-green for this workflow+branch

reason.description: Why this event fired: a real state change, or the at-most-once-per-24h reminder while a workflow stays red without an intervening green

bead_id.description: ID of the auto-filed triage bead in nervous-bus for this repo+workflow, if one has been created and is still open; null otherwise
